title: The Hollow Wolf
author: Ansel Galloway
blurb: Juniper Sandoval, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
